findings.summary: Canonicalization still publishes the retired expression-label callback type instead of the native hashable-key contract

All three generated graph copies contain the restrictive annotation. The product prose still says expression-compatible payloads. This is residual C2 metadata migration debt, not one of the separately deferred 27 scope/anchor mismatches.

The generated callback type excludes these return values.
